ideas.idea: Add street address and opening hours as page text, with Bakery/LocalBusiness JSON-LD
ideas.why: No page gives an address or hours, so people and tools can't answer where or when. Adding them as visible text is concrete. The JSON-LD part is optional but fine.

ideas.idea: Fix or add the missing hero image /img/loaves.jpg
ideas.why: The image isn't in the repository, so it may be broken. Fixing it is a concrete step for readers.

ideas.idea: List all loaves on the breads page, or give each its own page, to back up 'over twenty loaves'
ideas.why: The page names only two loaves while claiming twenty or more. A fuller list gives readers and machines real content.

ideas.idea: Add date, price, length and booking details to the classes page
ideas.why: The classes page has no schedule, price or way to book, which are the details a visitor needs.

ideas.idea: Explain how pre-ordering works, including how to order and the cut-off time
ideas.why: The home page mentions pre-order for weekend collection but gives no method or deadline.
This is standard advice for any site. It adds little here, and the choice not to have JSON-LD was deliberate.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to sitemap entries
ideas.why: The sitemap has only loc entries, which is accurate. lastmod is a small, widely applicable improvement.

ideas.idea: Add og:title and og:description social tags
ideas.why: The tags are missing, but this applies to nearly every site and has little effect on discovery.
Generic advice with no link to this site's findability. A static site's host usually controls 404 handling.
